author: NotWadeWilson
quote: The game is full or bugs and is terribly polished and while those 2 are alredy big issues it could be forgiven if at least the plot was good but it isnt, the gameplay is restrictive and punishing but not in a way that makes the game challenging but rather in a way that makes the game inconvinient the game pacing is slow even more so than rdr2 but without the reward after the slow pacing ends because the slow pacing NEVER ends at least in rdr2 things get interesting at some point here it never happens the characters are as deep as a puddle and as filthy as it too they have no personality and it feels like half of them were an self insert of one of the devs the graphics are the only good thing about this game and even so if you want good graphics there are better options the worst part of this game isnt even the bugs or the performance that can be fixed the plot of the game itself the poorly writen characters and the shallow world building are what make this game something you cant possibly enjoy if you have more than 2 braincells with both fighting for third place 0/10
